summary: Building and installing on your own workspace takes minutes with no approval. Going public is separate: distribution is a self-serve checklist, but Marketplace listing needs 10 active workspaces and up to about 10 weeks of review.

reason.text: App was created and installed to a test workspace in one flow with no approval step.
reason.label: tested
reason.note: Blank app path: 4 wizard steps, then Create and Install.

reason.text: Marketplace listing needs 10 active workspaces first, then a two-stage review lasting weeks to months.
reason.label: inferred
reason.note: Judgement from the install prerequisite and the review timeline in the Slack review guide.

claim.text: App created and installed in a single flow with no approval.
claim.label: tested

to_approval.display: Up to 10 business days, then up to 10 weeks (new app)

stages.name: Functional review
stages.duration_text: up to 10 weeks for new apps; 6 weeks for updates to published apps

claim.text: Slack states the preliminary and functional review timelines.
claim.label: official_docs
claim.evidence_quote: the preliminary part of the review takes up to 10 business days to receive feedback, while the functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions and 6 weeks for published apps resubmitting changes.

total_estimate.text: Roughly 12 weeks end to end for a new app, before any rework.
total_estimate.label: inferred
total_estimate.note: Sum of the two stated maxima. The docs do not say the stages run back to back, and the time to reach 10 active workspaces is not included.

steps.text: Open api.slack.com/apps, choose Create New App, then Blank app.
Pick a name and workspace; add only the bot scopes you need (an agent can propose the minimum list).
Skip event subscriptions unless required, since they add scopes.
Click Create and Install to install on your test workspace.
Add an HTTPS redirect URL (an agent can draft it); this unlocks the share link and token rotation.
Go public: complete the Manage Distribution checklist and activate. Not tested.
Reach 10 active workspaces, prepare test accounts, a demo video and scope reasons, then submit to the Marketplace.
